authorization_instruction: continue from here to as far as you can. dont stop for reports. you know i trust in your recommendations. complete the bootstraps if possible. but if you absolutely require my input for something thats a design choice that hasnt been decided yet, then defer it and build around it - if possible.

authoring.title: The certified controller produces bounded existing-contact brace commands
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR9.0 arithmetic fixtures, the declared controller seals one immutable configuration, mirrors signed angular-momentum-arrest requests, preserves reserve-aware unilateral feasibility, rate-limits commanded contact-load redistribution, reports desired and achieved residuals, retains command-not-measurement semantics, and enters STABILIZE only after the complete safe dwell.
authoring.scope: Only the exact controller configuration, digests, inputs, unilateral and reserve limits, load-rate limit, stable-dwell rule, source, and BR9.0 program scope certified by br9_20260723T160129Z_4023e51f.
authoring.mechanism: The controller maps a signed aggregate pitch-arrest request into complementary commanded left and right normal-load shares inside the declared finite envelope. The shares are commands, not measured per-foot loads.
applicability: Checking mirrored existing-contact pitch-arrest command arithmetic
Checking bounded load redistribution and stable-dwell handoff at the certified configuration
failure_boundaries: Arithmetic feasibility does not prove physical recovery outside the paired certified fixture
Commanded left and right shares are not measured per-foot loads
No new-contact catch step, free 3D bracing or standing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
unknowns: How the command law generalizes after releasing out-of-plane degrees of freedom
How morphology-specific reach, actuator limits, and compliant contacts change the feasible envelope

authoring.title: The certified feasibility layer refuses unsafe or unsupported brace requests
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR9.1 fixtures, the declared feasibility layer fails closed for insufficient reserved normal capacity, reserved friction-cone overflow, an absent pre-existing contact, REACTION_TOO_LATE, a non-BRACE observation, nonfinite momentum, caller-added root rescue, nonmonotonic ticks, and a configuration that reserves away its physical envelope.
authoring.scope: Only the exact request fields, controller configuration, reserve, friction, contact-set, detector-state, timing, finiteness, tick-order, source, and BR9.1 program scope certified by br9_20260723T160129Z_4023e51f.
authoring.mechanism: A strict pre-command gate requires complete typed inputs, an already-bearing contact set, viable detector timing, monotonic authority, and remaining unilateral, friction, and actuator reserve before it allows controller arithmetic to proceed.
applicability: Rejecting brace requests that exceed the certified existing-contact envelope
Rejecting hidden rescue channels, stale timing, malformed fields, and nonfinite state
failure_boundaries: Passing feasibility does not guarantee dynamic recovery
The gate authorizes no root force, foot pin, new support contact, repair, or guidance
No free 3D bracing or standing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
unknowns: How model uncertainty should reduce the usable reserve
Which viability estimator should replace the scaffold-specific timing gate in free 3D

authoring.title: The certified brace command retains provenance through finite paired actuators
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR9.2 fixture, one bounded brace command maps through the vertical contact-force seam into paired finite joint-torque plans, seals through the command ledger, executes only equal-and-opposite joint torques, reconciles append-only receipts, retains the no-root, no-pin, and no-new-contact boundaries, and rejects a forged direct root-force operation.
authoring.scope: Only the exact force map, paired actuator specifications, command ledger, executor, receipt contracts, fixture identities, source, and BR9.2 program scope certified by br9_20260723T160129Z_4023e51f.
authoring.mechanism: Digest-bound controller output is converted into finite paired joint torques, sealed before execution, and reconciled against append-only application receipts. The chain exposes what was commanded and applied without inventing a per-foot sensor.
applicability: Auditing the provenance of one certified existing-contact brace command
Rejecting direct root-force substitution and unreceipted intervention
failure_boundaries: A correct command chain does not prove that another limb or morphology can bear the load
Command receipts are not measured per-foot load allocation
No catch step, free 3D standing or bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
unknowns: How compliance, backlash, and actuator dynamics change command-to-effect accuracy
How to allocate aggregate support evidence among multiple contacts without false raw-impulse summation

authoring.title: The certified active fixture improves planar pitch arrest against its paired control
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR9.3 Godot/Jolt pair, the active controller begins on the first post-impulse observation, acts through finite paired actuators, retains both original already-bearing contacts, creates no new support contact, reconciles every command and receipt, remains within its declared rate and actuator limits, and reduces aggregate angular-momentum area and pitch excursion relative to a no-brace control receiving the same declared positive pitch impulse.
authoring.scope: Only the exact material BR7-derived planar scaffold, rigid bodies, passive hinges, already-bearing contacts, impulse, timing, finite actuators, controller, thresholds, timestep, solver, engine, source, and BR9.3 program scope certified by br9_20260723T160129Z_4023e51f.
authoring.mechanism: After the first post-impulse observation, the active arm redistributes commanded support through finite paired joint torques while the no-brace arm receives the same impulse without that controller path. Whole-system momentum reconstruction checks only the aggregate external pitch moment.
applicability: Checking one scaffold-constrained existing-contact pitch-arrest response against a paired same-impulse control
Checking causal command timing, original-contact retention, finite actuation, and receipt reconciliation
failure_boundaries: The unpowered guide materially locks out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw
Commanded contact shares and aggregate reconstruction do not establish measured per-foot allocation
The fixture creates no new support contact and therefore proves no catch step
No free 3D bracing or standing, articulated-limb generality, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
unknowns: Whether the response remains stable after releasing out-of-plane degrees of freedom
Whether other articulated limbs can realize the same load redistribution
How the controller should hand off to a new-contact catch step when the existing support set is insufficient
